description: This is a FastAPI-based backend API source file that handles contract document uploads, text extraction from PDFs, AI-powered analysis via OpenAI, and management of contract and deadline data in memory. It provides endpoints for contract listing, retrieval, uploading, insights, and deadline tracking.

classes.name: AnalysisResponse
classes.description: Response model for an analyzed contract.

classes.name: ContractSummary
classes.description: Lightweight summary returned in contract listings.

classes.name: ContractInsights
classes.description: Insights payload for a single contract.

classes.name: DeadlineItem
classes.description: Model representing an upcoming deadline item.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Return a simple health status message.

methods.name: list_contracts(token: Optional[str] = Depends(supabase_jwt_validator))
methods.description: Returns a list of contract summaries with brief info and insight presence.

methods.name: get_contract_detail(contract_id: str, token: Optional[str] = Depends(supabase_jwt_validator))
methods.description: Retrieve full extracted text and insights for a specified contract.

methods.name: upload_and_analyze_contract(file: UploadFile = File(...), token: Optional[str] = Depends(supabase_jwt_validator))
methods.description: Handles PDF upload, extracts text, calls AI analysis, and stores contract data.

methods.name: get_contract_insights( contract_id: str = Path(..., description="The contract identifier."), token: Optional[str] = Depends(supabase_jwt_validator), )
methods.description: Returns insights JSON string for a given contract.

methods.name: get_upcoming_deadlines( days: int = Query(7, ge=1, le=365, description="Number of days ahead to include"), token: Optional[str] = Depends(supabase_jwt_validator), )
methods.description: Fetches upcoming deadlines within specified days.
